newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux jumps on report but falls back.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux jumps on report but falls back.

text.p: Shares in Swedish appliance maker Electrolux jumped after the group released stronger than expected six-month figures.
When the figures hit traders' screens the share jumped from 617 crowns to 630 only to fall back and trade at 620 crowns at 1240 GMT, up five from its Tuesday close.
"The result was better than expected and the white goods development had strengthened in North America," a dealer said.
Electrolux posted a loss after financial items of 264 million crowns, compared to expectations of 305 million crowns. The loss stemmed from the group's restructuring programme.
